text: Reflection released the weights for Beam, its first open model, on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0. It has 501 billion parameters, 23 billion active per token, and a 1 million token context. Reflection says it matches GLM 5.2 on reasoning with 3 to 4 times less compute.
